caseName: Boehringer Mannheim Diagnostics, Inc. v. Pan American World Airways, Inc.
caseNameFull: Boehringer Mannheim Diagnostics, Inc., Formerly Known as Hycel, Inc. v. Pan American World Airways, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 5th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
